content.description: Iteration 3: refine best it02_s00; faster car discharge, stronger red-running with weaker swarm (var/mean), higher early-start p, more sidewalk seeking, longer box lag.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car (0.70 s vs 0.39 s, R 7) and M5/length (39 m vs 13 m): tau 0.65 to 0.5, minGap 1.0 and sigma 0.05 shorten the start-up headway so the queue discharges within green; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.
M1/car: minimum tau 0.4 for a minority pulls the mean car headway further toward 0.39 s; no red-running attributes because M3/share/car is about 0.003.

M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4): impatience 0.6 to 0.8 and jmDriveAfterRedTime 8 s let more riders drive on after red; sigma 0.1 and minimum tau/minGap target M1/moto (0.47 vs 0.30 s) and M5/length; lcSublane 5 and low minGapLat keep M4/overshoot_share pressure.
Behaviour 10 only: M6/approach moto times are above observed, so the slow group is cut from 5% to 3% to reduce blocking while keeping the slow_lane_center mechanism.

M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27, weight 0.10) and M9a/per_cycle (0.34 vs 0.33): 5% custom1 seekers with the same fast-discharge parameters as moto_std; right-lane draws stay rare so M9a is kept near target.
M7a/release_time and M7b/clear_lag: it02_s01 settings (release_time 0.16 s, clear_lag 8.5 s) were nearer than s00 (-11.9 s); jmTimegapMinor 1.0 kept and the extra hold is set by release_lag_s.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto (0.025 vs 0.13): raise p from 0.5 to 0.9 over the full 10 s window and 5 m/s so more front-row riders actually cross before green; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).
M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4) need a higher base rate; M3/var_to_mean was 3.1 vs 1.3 with k 0.08, so k drops to 0.02 and p_max to 0.6 to cut the clustering.

M10a/per_cycle: 0.03 vs 0.27 with p_sidewalk 0.06 on 10% seekers, so p_sidewalk rises to 0.5 on 5% seekers with a 10 m trigger near the observed 13 m choice queue; p_right_lane 0.01 keeps M9a/M9b share_blocked low; p_wrong_lane 0 because it is inapplicable (R27).
M7a/release_time (0.2-0.6 s vs 2.59 s) and M7c/slope (0.10-0.18 vs 0.33 s/veh): a longer extra hold of 2.5 s moves box exit after the opposing green end later; M7b/clear_lag stays near 6.7 s.
Behaviour 10: slow riders keep the lane centre; unchanged because M4/lat_moto (7.19 vs 7.085 m) is already near target.

reasoning: Refined best spec it02_s00 (S 1.047): faster discharge for M1/M5, stronger red/early start with lower swarm k for var/mean, more sidewalk seeking for M10a, longer box lag.
